entries.rationale: The phase-start batch test never observed concurrency. Its replacement submits five production RunManager jobs and proves the shared semaphore admits exactly two workers while all five complete.
The test now samples one non-boundary coordinate through the real terrain stack and checks the expected grid cell in every named layer.
entries.strongest_oracle: height, land-cover, bathymetry, and population queries equal their independently selected cell values

entries.rationale: The phase-start test accepted and silently discarded retired calibration data. Its replacement names the fail-closed contract and proves typed validation rejects advance_speed instead of converting it into an empty patch.
entries.strongest_oracle: tests/unit/simulation/test_calibration_schema.py::TestCalibrationSchemaEdgeCases::test_dead_key_rejected observes an exact unsupported-dead-calibration error for advance_speed

entries.rationale: The former no-crash observation now compares identical seeded communications with and without authored network load.
entries.strongest_oracle: loaded-network message latency is strictly greater than the unloaded control

entries.rationale: The former discarded return values now drive one catalog-backed satellite through the real overpass hysteresis boundary at 100, 159, and 220 seconds.
entries.strongest_oracle: the first and post-gap calls return the exact satellite, the inside-gap call is empty, and persisted last-overpass time advances to 220 seconds

entries.rationale: The empty-loadout no-crash probe could not demonstrate engagement and was removed; Phase 109 already supplies real production-path ON_STATION engagement evidence.
entries.strongest_oracle: tests/integration/test_phase_109_battle_sensor_domains.py::test_multidomain_fire_control_radar_allows_real_aerial_engagement asserts a real F-16 loadout produces an aerial engagement event

entries.rationale: The test now uses a real EventBus and naval engine, observes a successful engagement, and validates the emitted domain event.
entries.strongest_oracle: positive hit count and exact NavalEngagementEvent attacker, target, and weapon values

entries.rationale: The phase-start test treated silent dead-key loss as successful parsing. Its replacement names the rejection contract and proves direct typed construction fails on advance_speed.
entries.strongest_oracle: tests/unit/test_phase49_calibration_schema.py::TestSchemaConstruction::test_dead_key_advance_speed_rejected observes an exact unsupported-dead-calibration error for advance_speed

entries.rationale: Activation is now checked through both persisted engine state and the public event bus.
entries.strongest_oracle: the planned stratagem is active and one exact StratagemActivatedEvent is observed

entries.rationale: The constructor/no-raise probe now runs matched fatigue managers and observes the temperature-stress effect.
entries.strongest_oracle: stressed physical and mental fatigue are each greater than the zero-stress control

entries.rationale: The discrete integration test now mirrors the public kernel with an independent seeded RNG and checks returned and persisted state.
entries.strongest_oracle: returned and checkpoint-visible morale state equal the independently sampled discrete-kernel state

entries.rationale: The continuous integration test now mirrors the public kernel with an independent seeded RNG and checks returned and persisted state.

entries.strongest_oracle: both sides move toward one another while preserving their spatial order
